title: Ian Henry - Past Life
htmlContent:
Ian Henry gives his all to his fans and music on his new song “Past Life”. He lays it all out there for the world to take in, with a melodic flow that pushes every bar right to the chest of the listener. The lyrics are heavy and he carries them to the fullest, with transparency that helps the authenticity of this genre live on through the music.
